{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes multiple consecutive 0.00 or low positive values (e.g., 0.00, 0.00, 0.00).",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods (e.g., first 5 days of 30d forecast) when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >10% below), reduce forecast by 5-15% for next period.",
    "When sentiment shifts from negative to neutral/positive, adjust forecast to reflect gradual recovery, not immediate rebound."
  ]
}
